2020.change_reason: First available year; it is the baseline 'About Us' page built around purpose, a 117-year history and a founder quote.
2020.analyst_notes: Warm, heritage-driven tone with purpose language about 'a better world'. Concrete claims are few, and the climate reference ('our climate') is a single phrase.

2021.change_reason: The copy was rewritten around services, experiences and software, added a 'family company' framing and an 'Our culture' paragraph on belonging, and dropped the climate phrasing.
2021.analyst_notes: The tone moves from heritage and purpose toward trust and inclusion ('serve the world with integrity and competence', 'a culture of belonging'). The claims are aspirational and carry no metrics.

2022.change_reason: The captured text is identical to 2021.
2022.analyst_notes: Identical copy to 2021, so tone and specificity are unchanged.

2023.change_reason: The 'Our culture' paragraph on belonging and shared ideals was removed, and the rest of the copy is the same.
2023.analyst_notes: The removal is notable because the belonging paragraph was the only explicit DEI-type statement on the page. The remaining copy is generic and aspirational.

2024.change_reason: Only the years-in-business count changed to 121, plus a minor rewording ('That is why we are evolving'), so there is no substantive change.
2024.analyst_notes: Essentially the 2023 copy. The page remains aspirational and light on specifics, with no culture section.
